verdict.rationale: Anthropic's own docs describe building with Claude Code in your terminal and have a dedicated 'Claude Code CLI' article covering screen reader mode. Community posts confirm that people use the Claude Code CLI. One user reported an unresponsive terminal, but that single anecdote does not contradict the CLI's existence or availability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party CLI docs (installation, commands, scripting/headless use) and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of AI-native workflow use.
